conversation.content: Start a deployment record for the payments API.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/service/name", "value": "payments-api"}]
Set this up for staging to start.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/environment/name", "value": "staging"}]
Use the usual staging workspace for it.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/environment/namespace", "value": "payments-staging"}]
Point traffic at the staging address customers use for testing.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/ingress/primaryHost", "value": "payments-api.staging.example.com"}]
Have it pull credentials from the staging vault entry.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/secrets/paymentProviderRef", "value": "vault://staging/payments-api/provider"}]
Send staging incidents to the payments test responders.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/alerts/route", "value": "payments-staging-oncall"}]
Keep it on the staging rollout stream.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/release/channel", "value": "staging"}]
Run three copies of the service for now.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/deployment/replicas", "value": 3}]
Also include the internal staging address the cluster will use.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/ingress/internalHost", "value": "payments-api.staging.svc.cluster.local"}]
Use the staging TLS certificate bundle for HTTPS.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/secrets/tlsCertificateRef", "value": "vault://staging/payments-api/tls"}]

edit_instruction: Change the deployment environment to production.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a service configured for one environment, where namespace, hostnames, secret references, alert routing, and release channel all follow from the environment's supplied attributes. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a deployment record would carry that do not depend on the environment, and vary their number from sample to sample. Do not embed a lookup or reference card for any environment inside the artifact; the artifact holds only the current environment's own fields.
edit_pattern: Move the deployment to a different specific environment, and supply the target environment's attributes in master_data.
cascade_pattern: Every environment-governed field takes the replacement environment's supplied attributes: namespace, hostnames, secret references, alert routing, and release channel. Service-specific fields that do not depend on the environment stay unchanged. This is determined because the replacement environment's attributes are provided with the edit.
